title: The Best Study Plan for Besties

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: I mean, I knew it was gonna be bad, but our classic lit and kanji quizzes sooo do not pass the vibe check!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: I can't even with these characters! What are they? Like some kind of code? There's no way I can memorize all these!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Group studying's great and all, but I don't even have the energy to turn the pages in my textbook…

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: C'mon, girlypops, we gotta do this! We won't be able to finish studying if we don't start first!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: What the heck does "His manners were wanting" even mean? You know what I want? Something sweet!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: That sounds so yum! Let's hit up a karaoke place after this, fam! I'm so getting the all-you-can-eat ice cream!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Now that's an idea I can get behind. We should order fries while we're there. I think the place by the station has—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Wait, back up, y'all! We've gotta stop yapping and focus!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Hey, that's it! I just thought of something awesome!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Classic lit's just a bunch of words written down, but if we use them while chatting, maybe we can remember them better!

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Whoa! That idea is gas, Palmer! ☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: I confess, Miss Palmer's idea is a rather ingenious one. Ooh, that sounded pretty old-timey, didn't it?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Greetings, Palmer! The notes thou lent me hath proved straight fire. Allow me to treat you to a veritable feast!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Why, think nothing of it! We must learn as one and grow as one!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Dang! You two sound like you walked right out of our classic lit books!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Palmer's vivid imagination leads her and her friends to new heights!
